equity.level_reason: Units are health departments; comparisons are by department type and jurisdiction population size, neither a social-position dimension of persons.

level_alternative.reason: Jurisdiction population size could be read as a rurality proxy, but it is a characteristic of non-human units.

equity.equity_measurement: Jurisdiction population size (small/medium/large) of health departments is a geographic unit attribute, not an SPD.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional from 'national survey of STD programs'. The logistic model's covariates are not stated; it appears to contain only department type. The National Profile of Local Health Departments survey served only as a sampling frame.
view_issues: Summary says one fourth of state and 39.4% of local departments field-tested, but Table 1 and results give local 25.0%, state 39.4% (reversed). Table 2 follow-up 'Yes' 100% plus 'Don't know' exceeds 100%.
